Recorded claim:
Bug 1882574 renamed msgIOAuth2Module.initFromSmtp to initFromOutgoing and changed OAuth2Module to read the generic server URI and legacy prefs. SmtpAuthenticator still called initFromSmtp. A follow-up two days later changed that call to initFromOutgoing, fixing the missed OAuth2 SMTP authentication path. Trace consumers of a renamed XPCOM method, including runtime paths that compile or lint without exposing the error. The accepted follow-up is D210038.

Provenance: e9328ee25a8cde38d48c1d699613b51f99d9d4fc8e608fd2abf1e4cc30a0ee88. Original evidence IDs: 09c782940f15619a2bc57874a912a2c59a4cf8e8f54ea5f02c90ee8af6d8dc20, f42476c7a7a0bf31e61c49c910dbee8801182f2f4a0b312b9bfdbefcb6ec1342, f7a3b4684ba4ce8358412ba11c89c837e4747621c0b0c7e5824952d5107de67a.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.

title: Recorded lesson: Interface renames must include authentication call sites, not only the interface and implementation
